notes.text: The first operation is described as filling holes selected by a closed one-dimensional submanifold of the boundary, equivalently a subset of the free-edge components. The source uses cones on the boundary components and describes deleting the corresponding free graph edges and marking points above them while retaining vertex weights. This records the source claim without independently proving it.

The mixed operation is attached to a clopen part R-prime union Sigma-prime of R union Sigma with R-prime containing R intersect Sigma-prime. The source writes an equivalent part R-prime union A-prime of R union A, with R-prime containing R vertical-bar A-prime. The bar is retained as written; no additional mathematical interpretation is imposed.

At graph level the source removes the corresponding vector-R-prime part and contracts the stated A-prime edges, both free and linked, while carrying along the weights. The old A-prime subscript is overworked and does not securely support H's live ell. The article group after enlever remains uncertain. These are transcription limits, not mathematical corrections.

The raised formula row contains an insertion subsequently cancelled (A-prime union R-prime), its live replacement R-prime union Sigma-prime, and raised de R union Sigma. The main-line quelconque and des are cancelled below it. The cancelled components phrase begins with a separate doubtful un, and the next-line R union Sigma continuation is also crossed through.

Both drafts omit the small letter-like group below et telle and the separate word before ens.; the proposed que and un remain explicitly doubtful. Below et telle, an insertion leader alone is the alternative. The only possible article after enlever is in one overwritten group; there is no separately written la before partie.

The isolated crossed sign is transcribed as doubtful cancelled 4), including its visible right curved stroke. H's editorial interpretation as a reference cross remains possible. No independent diagram or pictorial drawing appears on this sheet.

The possible commas after cancelled A union R and cancelled R union Sigma are joined to the strike returns and remain doubtful. No comma follows upper live R union Sigma, and no independent comma follows fermée.

The handwritten top number 11 and lower-left folio 54 are retained. The lower numeral is lighter than the main writing; its attribution to a separate hand is provisional. Scan 55 is an editorial locator, not source ink. The line count includes main text rows, separate revision rows, the isolated crossed sign and both number positions.

The original was viewed once for layout and both prepared halves once line by line, including agreed witness readings. All eleven cited first-reading crops were directly inspected. No OCR, external source, TeX compilation or independent proof check was used. The first five crop displays initially exceeded available context; their images were inspected separately before crop-based decisions were finalized.
